item.title: Former Fort Bend County Constable Trever Nehls announces bid for Congress in Texas' 22nd District
item.description: Former Fort Bend County Precinct 4 Constable Trever Nehls announced his candidacy for Congress in Texas' 22nd District, joining the race to succeed his brother, U.S. Rep. Troy Nehls, who announced on Saturday that he will not seek re-election.

item.title: Fulshear's Dozier's BBQ expands to downtown Houston food hall
item.description: Tyler Risinger, the original owner's great-grandson, leads the concept. The family reopened Dozier's in Fulshear in August 2024 after the business had closed in March under different ownership.

item.title: Supreme Court upholds Texas redistricting
item.description: On Thursday, the Supreme Court said that the state can use the new map in 2026 — reversing a lower court ruling from last month that found the new boundaries be unconstitutional.

item.title: President Trump to pardon Texas Democrat Henry Cuellar
item.description: President Donald Trump announced he will pardon U.S. Rep. Henry Cuellar, D-Laredo, and his wife, ending the congressman's multi-year federal legal battle. Cuellar had faced a dozen charges of bribery, money laundering and conspiracy.

item.title: Trump endorses Trever Nehls for Congress, Jetton quits, Clark unfazed
item.description: President Donald Trump endorsed Trever Nehls on Thursday for Texas' 22nd Congressional District, prompting former state Rep. Jacey Jetton to drop out of the race just days after announcing his candidacy.

item.title: Reestablishing a Katy Christmas season tradition
item.description: A Christmas tree made of lights atop the old Cardiff Rice Dryer was lit Wednesday, a renewal of a tradition that began decades ago.

item.title: McCoy announces County Judge run, Shike moves to Precinct 4 race

item.title: Series of events kicks off Christmas season in Katy
item.description: Katy kicked off the Christmas season Saturday with a Nutcracker Exchange, the annual City of Katy Christmas tree lighting ceremony and Christmas on the Park, staged by the Katy Heritage Society.

item.title: Waller County Judge Trey Duhon will not seek re-election
item.description: Waller County Judge Trey Duhon said Monday he would not seek a fourth term in office.
